title: Open the Otherside portal
keywords: deeper darker portal deep dark ancient city Warden
description: Use a Warden’s Heart of the Deep to activate the Ancient City gateway in Deeper and Darker.

materials.label: Ancient City Portal Frame
materials.description: Use the existing Reinforced Deepslate frame in the city.

materials.label: Torch
materials.description: Bring light and blocks to mark your return route.

steps.title: Find the Ancient City’s central frame
steps.text: Look for the large Reinforced Deepslate gateway above the center of the city. Mark the return route before you explore the surrounding sculk.

steps.title: Get a Heart of the Deep
steps.text: Defeat a Warden and pick up its Heart of the Deep. Keep the heart in your inventory when you return to the city frame.

steps.title: Use the heart on the frame
steps.text: Hold the heart and right-click the Reinforced Deepslate at the base of the opening. Once the portal fills, step through to the Otherside. Mark the far-side gateway before leaving it.

figure.alt: Front view of the natural Reinforced Deepslate frame in the Ancient City. Use the Heart of the Deep on a frame block.

tips.title: The frame still won’t open
tips.text: Use the Heart of the Deep on the central city frame. Check that the frame is intact and remove sculk veins or other blocks obstructing the opening.
